title: How I work
subtitle: The same four steps whether I'm building solo, inside a team or alongside an external development partner.

items.title: Understand the problem
items.description: I start with the people who will use it, not the ticket. Requirements, edge cases and the process behind them - before a single line of code.

items.title: Design the model
items.description: Data model and API first. Get those right and the UI, the tests and every later feature fall into place instead of fighting each other.

items.title: Ship iteratively
items.description: Small, working increments in front of real users early. Feedback shapes the tool while it is still cheap to change.

items.title: Own it in production
items.description: Deployment, CI/CD, monitoring and the bug reports that follow. I stay responsible for what I build after it goes live.
